about_short_description.short_description: Happl is your personalised benefits and engagement platform for global teams.

product.name: Global Employee Benefits Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates and manages employee benefits globally, ensuring compliance and reducing administrative tasks for HR and finance teams.

product.name: Happl Health Insurance
product.description: A service offering tailored health insurance plans for individuals and teams with automated onboarding and compliance features.

product.name: Integrated Insurance Management
product.description: A platform feature that automates insurance enrolments, provider data synchronization, and compliance management to reduce manual administration.

product.name: Flex Benefits & Expenses Management
product.description: A system to assign, track, and manage employee allowances for wellbeing, remote work, learning, and other flexible benefits.

product.name: Salary Sacrifice Schemes
product.description: Automated management of tax-efficient salary sacrifice benefits like cycle-to-work and electric vehicle schemes, ensuring compliance and payroll integration.

product.name: Rewards & Recognition Automation
product.description: A tool to automate employee rewards and recognition by sending gifts, perks, and allowances without adding administrative burden.
